title: A valid missing completion must continue the same unfinished action without replay

anchor.relationship: Direct owner refinement: script action and receipt remain authoritative until its actual required completion is accepted; preserve partial work and cold-session recovery. S-1 and S-10 remain protected.

proposal: Derive the current valid completion operation read-only from existing action/receipt/pass state. A same-session stop continues remaining work and names that operation. Valid recorded Improve passes are submitted without rerecording. Fresh driver sessions first recover the existing packet once; real callback validation alone advances. Preserve paused/blocked states, ownership, corrupt-state fail-open, timeout/failure exits and existing user limits. No automatic callback or restart.
